text: Long catch-up with Ravi over lunch. He's got a second interview at the bank on May 14 at 10am, panel this time, and he's properly nervous. Still playing five-a-side Tuesdays. Text him good luck the night before.
Marisol and Juan finally found a flat in Leith. They move June 3rd. Her mum is coming over from Valencia to help with the boxes. Juan's started knitting, of all things, says it calms him down.

Coffee with Chen. Applied for the UX lead role at Monzo, hears back by 5/22. Her partner Emil is doing the Edinburgh marathon that weekend. She's obsessed with Wingspan at the moment, owns every expansion.

Rory's viewing two flats in Glasgow Saturday at 11 and then 2pm, one in Partick and one in Dennistoun. He's been rejected for four already and sounds pretty fed up. His girlfriend Eilidh is staying with her parents in Stirling until they find somewhere, which isn't helping his mood. Must call him Sunday to see how it went.
Seo-yeon got the job!! Starts at the museum archive on July 7. She plays cello in an amateur orchestra, concert is the 19th at half 7. Her brother Liam might come up from London for it.
Siobhan O'Brien rang. Dad's moving into sheltered housing on the 12th, she's taking the week off to sort it. She's knackered. Check in with her midweek.
Bumped into Mehmet at the climbing wall. He's training for a bouldering comp, April 27 at 9am. Supports Galatasaray, won't shut up about the derby. Wife Nia is expecting in the autumn.
Dawit said the Leeds flat fell through, landlord pulled out last minute. Now looking in Bradford instead. He has a phone interview with Arup tomorrow morning at 8:30.
Need to post Agnieszka's housewarming present before the 2nd. She mentioned a nice Le Creuset would go down well. Party's Saturday 2nd at 7pm, new place in Didsbury.
Kerry and Phoebe have booked viewings in Bristol for March 9th. Kerry's interviewing at the university the same morning, 10 o'clock, so it's a double trip. Phoebe's dog Biscuit is going with them.
Lunch with Hiroshi and his sister Rin. Hiroshi's into vintage synths now, bought a Juno-60. Rin is finishing her PhD in September and applying for postdocs in Berlin. Rin's lovely, quiet.
Interview at Deliveroo is Thursday at 2pm. Prepping case study tonight and tomorrow evening.
Nasser's engagement party is cancelled, his fiance's grandad is ill. They're going to do something small in December instead. Send Nasser a message, just to say thinking of them.

Caught up with Luca and Rana at the pub. Rana's going to miss him loads, they've shared a desk for six years. Luca's a Spurs season ticket holder for 20 years, still loves it despite everything. He's moving to Turin with work on August 1st, flight is the 30th of July at 6am. Wants a send-off drink the week before.
Ricardo had his assessment centre at Deloitte on Monday. Didn't say much. Ask him how it went when I see him Friday.

Magda's kids start at the new school 9/4. They moved to Norwich in the summer and her eldest is struggling to settle, crying before bed most nights. The younger one loves it already, joined the swimming club on day one. Her husband's commuting back to London three days a week which isn't helping.
Rana is a massive Taylor Swift fan, has tickets for June 21. Her birthday is June 18th. Hint: she wants the vinyl box set.

Mihai mentioned he's applied for about thirty jobs since being made redundant in March, mostly logistics and warehouse management. His wife has picked up extra shifts. Second round with Ocado on 5/9 at 11am. He's trying to stay positive but you can tell. I should ring him the evening after.
Quick one. Eilidh - curling club Wednesdays, captain this year. Lives in Stirling now.
Dr Shah moving practices in June, so need to register somewhere new before then.
Hadiza and her husband Mohammed are flying to Lagos on April 15th for her cousin's wedding. Back the 29th. She's making her own aso ebi outfit, sews brilliantly. Take her to lunch when they're back.

Talked to James for ages about his interview at Rolls-Royce. It's not until the 23rd at 3pm but he's already losing sleep over it, rewriting his answers every night. His wife says he barely ate at the weekend. Their cat Pickle had surgery last week, recovering fine. James supports Derby County, poor lad.
Marta's flat viewing went well yesterday, offer goes in tomorrow by noon. If they get it, moving May 30. Her girlfriend Lena wants a garden for the chickens.
Siddharth (Sid) finally finished the 1000-piece puzzle of the Bayeux Tapestry. Next up: building a model railway in the loft. He's retiring in July, last day the 18th.

Long FaceTime with Chen and Emil tonight. Emil got through to the final round at Spotify, flying to Stockholm on 6/11 for the onsite, 9am start. Chen's going with him to look at apartments in case. They've got two viewings booked the 12th, morning and afternoon. Her parents are a bit wary about the move. Chen says the hardest bit will be leaving her book club.
Get Ravi a card for the 14th whatever happens. Good luck one if before, congrats if after.
Agnieszka's younger brother moving in with her for a few months while he looks for work. She's not thrilled. She's taken up pottery, Thursday nights at the community centre.
Rory didn't get the Partick flat. Now considering going back to his mum's for a bit. Don't forget to send him the listing I saw on Gumtree.
Liam's band is playing the Brudenell on October 28 at 8pm. He's on bass. Nervous because a label person might be there. Rory and I are going.
Kerry got the Bristol job! Start date 1/6. Phoebe still deciding whether to give notice at the NHS trust or go part-time remotely.
Sorted the van for moving day, Friday 8am pick-up from Enterprise. Keys to the new place at 1.
Mehmet says Nia's due date is November 3rd. They've painted the nursery green. He's been reading every baby book going, mostly at 2am.
Nothing much. Coffee with Juan, talked football and the weather.
Seo-yeon's orchestra rehearsal clashes with her new job induction on the 8th. She's trying to swap. Her cat Mochi has been sick on everything this week.
Hiroshi asked whether I'd do a reference for his application to Bandai Namco. Need to send it before the deadline, March 31st at 5pm.
Called Mrs Baker about the flat. She's happy for us to view Wednesday after work, around 6. The current tenant, Dawit, moving out end of the month, nice bloke, heading to Bradford.

Lena's grandmother passed away on Sunday, very peaceful apparently, she was 94. Lena was really close to her, spent every summer there as a kid. Funeral is the 17th in Gdansk, she flies out the 15th. She and Marta are going together. Must send flowers to the house before she goes.
Phoebe's gotten really into bouldering, goes with Mehmet sometimes. Her new board game cafe idea is still on, looking at units in Clifton.
Ricardo didn't get Deloitte. Bit gutted but he has another interview at PwC on 11/12 at 9:30. Plays guitar in a covers band, they're doing a wedding in December.
Nia and Mehmet's baby shower is Saturday the 14th at 3. Need to buy something off the list, she said the sling would be great.
Eilidh's team won the regional curling final! Nationals in Perth on February 20, 10am draw. She's never been to nationals before and is anxious. Her dad's driving her up.
Siobhan's dad is settled in the new place now. She seems lighter. She's going back to her ceramics class and wants to apply for a part-time role at the gallery, deadline 4/30.

Magda's eldest had a better week at school. Magda's thinking of moving them back to London next year if the husband's commute doesn't get easier. She volunteered to run the school's chess club, which is very her.
Luca's leaving do is the 24th at the Crown, 7ish. Collection going round for a gift, Rana's organising it. Give Rana a tenner.
Rin's postdoc interview in Berlin is on 2/10 at 2pm their time, so 1pm here. She's prepping a 20-minute talk on the sea ice data. Wish her luck the day before.
Juan's new hobby is fermenting hot sauce. Kitchen smells insane. Marisol has banned it from the bedroom.
Nasser and his fiance are doing the small do on December 6th after all, back garden, about twenty people. His fiance's grandad is out of hospital. I'm bringing the barbecue.
Mihai got the Ocado job, starts in two weeks, Monday 19th at 9. Absolutely thrilled. He's celebrating at the Romanian place on Friday night. I should get him a bottle of something.
Meeting with the letting agent tomorrow at 4 to sign the lease. Then deposit transfer Thursday morning.
Nia mentioned her sister Hadiza's starting a fashion degree at Central Saint Martins in September, at 34. Really proud of her.
James had the Rolls-Royce interview yesterday. Thinks it went OK, they said they'd let him know by Friday the 27th. Text him on Friday afternoon if he hasn't said anything.
Rana's moving to Manchester in the new year, January 10th probably. Already bought a Man City shirt to fit in, though she knows nothing about football. Mohammed is helping with the van.

Chen and Emil decided not to go to Stockholm after all, the Spotify offer was too low. They're staying put and buying the flat downstairs from Chen's parents instead. Completion date is 8/15. Emil's sulking a bit but Chen's relieved. She's started a new book club, first one is next Thursday at 7.

Seo-yeon's brother Liam is applying to drama schools, auditions in London on March 3rd and 4th. He's done three monologues and practises them on the bus. Seo-yeon says he's terrified. I'll send him a good luck message on the 2nd.
Agnieszka Novak had her pottery exhibition on Saturday, sold four pieces! Her brother came, surprisingly. Congratulate her properly next time.
Kerry and Phoebe's dog Biscuit went missing in the new neighbourhood for a whole night. Found at the park next morning. Phoebe was in bits. Their moving-in party is now on the 22nd at 6pm.
Hiroshi's started Duolingo Korean so he can talk to Seo-yeon's mum. Bless him.

Dawit settled into Bradford, lovely flat near the park. Arup offered him the job, starts September 2nd at 9am. His mum's visiting from Addis in October, first time in the UK. Ask him to bring her round for dinner.

Talked to Ricardo and his partner Siddharth tonight. Sid's knee surgery is booked for 10/3 at 8am, Ricardo's taking him. Sid's worried about not getting back to cycling. Ricardo's PwC result comes in on the 5th. A lot on for them both. Drop round with food the weekend after.
Mohammed's football team, the Sunday league one, got promoted. He's the goalkeeper. Nasser plays left back. Big end of season do on May 25 at 8pm, partners welcome.
